description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder, testing its behavior including adding, setting, removing elements, equality, and building a JsonArray.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayBuilderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for immutable JSON array builder, verifying method correctness and coverage.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder before each test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods conform to expectations.

methods.name: tryToAddFurtherBooleanNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null boolean throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddFurtherIntegerNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null integer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddFurtherLongNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null long throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddFurtherDoubleNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null double throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddStringNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddJsonValueNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null JsonValue throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddAllJsonValueNull
methods.description: Tests that adding null collection of JsonValues throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToRemoveWithNull
methods.description: Tests that removing null element throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getValueAtValidPositionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that retrieving value at a valid position returns the correct JsonValue.

methods.name: getValueAtInvalidPositionReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that trying to get value at invalid position returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: tryToSetBooleanValueAtInvalidPosition
methods.description: Ensures setting a boolean at invalid index throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.

methods.name: setValueAtValidPositionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that setting a valid value at a valid position updates the array correctly.

methods.name: tryToSetNullString
methods.description: Ensures that setting null string throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: tryToSetNullJsonValue
methods.description: Ensures that setting null JsonValue throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: tryToRemoveValueAtInvalidPosition
methods.description: Verifies that removing value at invalid position throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.

methods.name: removeValueAtValidPositionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that removing value at a valid position behaves correctly.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getSize returns correct number of elements.

methods.name: isEmptyWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that isEmpty reflects the current state accurately.

methods.name: buildReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that build constructs the JsonArray with the expected elements.
